thread:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — high 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate across prod clusters (eu-west, us-central). Alert ID: PD-98321. Threshold breached: 5xx > 8% for 2m. https://pagerduty.example/PD-98321
Kevin L: acked on PD, I'm looking. seeing spike in both regions?
Anya P: also saw alerts. Customer-facing errors reported in EU first, then US. Any known deploys?
PagerBot: Assigned to Kevin L (primary), escalation to Oncall Rotations if no ack in 5m. Logs: attached sampling link (internal).
Kevin L: pulling recent logs: `curl -s http://logs.internal/query?q=5xx_spike&limit=100` -> lots of `upstream http 502` from inference-backend.
Sara M: I can check LB health — hitting backend instance pool failures. Starting with eu-west.
Kevin L: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference -o wide` shows many Ready=0/1 in eu-west.
Mike T: are we seeing OOM or crashloop?
Kevin L: container restarts high, exit code 137 on some. memory pressure looks likely.
Anya P: stack shows KV cache growth for longer sequences. Recent prod load pattern changed — more long prompts from customer X after midnight.
Zach R: rolling fallback: can we route long sequence traffic to smaller model or throttle max tokens at gateway?
Kevin L: proposing immediate mitigations: 1) enable autoscale burst (increase node pool by +2 in eu-west), 2) apply temporary routing rule to limit max_input_tokens=2048, 3) enable model-fallback to quantized variant for requests > 1024. Anyone object?
Sara M: starting node pool increase now: `gcloud container clusters resize prod-eu --node-pool=redwood-pool --num-nodes=12`
Mike T: I'll deploy a transient nginx rate limit at edge for the route to cap concurrency per IP.
Anya P: I can flip the routing policy to fallback model for long requests: config patch inbound now.
Kevin L: executing `kubectl rollout restart deployment inference-service -n prod` in eu-west for warm cache cleanup (will drain gracefully).
PagerBot: Note: changing routing policies may increase latency for affected requests. Marking potential customer impact.
Sara M: nodes coming up, pods scheduling. Preliminary 5xx rate dropping from 11.6% -> 4.3% in eu-west over last 2 minutes.
Zach R: US still elevated ~6.5%. Might take longer; no node scale triggered in us-central yet.
Mike T: edge rate limit live. Observing some client retries, but 5xx trend improving.
Kevin L: enabling prefix KV cache trim to remove long-lived caches: `redis-cli SREM kvcache:long_keys ...` (manual prune). Doing in small batches.
Anya P: applied model-fallback rule. Telemetry shows fewer large-ctx model allocations.
PagerBot: PD incident status changed to acknowledged by Kevin L at 1769801250.
Kevin L: after autoscale and routing changes, error rate eu-west stable ~2.1%. us-central down to 3.8%. Continuing to monitor.
Sara M: health checks back to green on most hosts. A few noisy pods still in restart loop — investigating container memory limits.
Mike T: I bumped memory limit on the deployment from 6Gi -> 8Gi for the affected revision; will observe for 5 minutes.
Zach R: can we capture a reproducible request set for postmortem? We need to correlate customer X session IDs.
Anya P: saved traces and sample requests to s3://redwood-incidents/PD-98321/ and flagged top 50 by token-length.
Kevin L: good. starting a one-line incident postmortem draft in #postmortems after this thread. Action items: (1) add autoscale policy to trigger earlier on sustained long-ctx traffic, (2) add circuit-breaker at gateway per-customer, (3) tune KV cache eviction thresholds, (4) add better OOM alerting on pods.
PagerBot: If no ack escalation, Oncall Rotations will be paged. Handoff note: Kevin L handing to Oncall Rotations in 20m if mitigations hold but need longer term follow-up.
Sara M: 15m in — 5xx under 1.5% across both regions; latency slightly elevated but within SLO.
Mike T: confirming no ongoing deploys and rollback not needed.
Kevin L: marking incident as under control. I'll remain on watch for another 20m then hand to next oncall for follow-up.
Anya P: thumbs for postmortem. Please include customer impact window and mitigation timeline.
Zach R: added DB of known large workload customers to runbook item.
PagerBot: Incident update: mitigations applied, error rate reduced. Monitoring for 20m. PD incident updated with notes.
Kevin L: handing to Oncall Rotations for follow-up at 1769801499 — see runbook link. Thanks team.
Oncall Rotations: acknowledged handoff. Assigned follow-up to Sara M and Zach R for root cause and runbook updates.
PagerBot: PagerDuty incident status: resolved (manual close pending PM review).
Kevin L: closing thread here. Follow-ups in #postmortems and a scheduled ticket in the backlog (INF-4721). :white_check_mark:
